rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on every northstar_simulation table, then drops score, run_evidence, trust_tier, simulation_definition and the northstar_simulation schema (CASCADE). run_evidence holds immutable, tamper-evident run evidence and simulation_definition holds a restricted scoring_key, so on a shared environment export the schema first (uninstall policy export_then_delete) and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_simulation schema with simulation_definition, trust_tier, run_evidence and score tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every northstar_simulation table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: Phase 5 simulation module (versioned definitions, signed leases, sandboxed runs, hash-chained evidence, deterministic scoring, scoped AI coaching) baseline
